name: Recess
description: Join a group of six fourth-grade best friends at Third Street Elementary School on their fun-filled adventures in their school playground. Through the ups-and-downs of adolescence, they must wrestle with authority, avoid the school snitch, and try their best to win at kick-ball.

videos.title: Recess: School's Out
videos.overview: TJ and company must save summer vacation from disappearing forever.

videos.title: Recess Christmas: Miracle on Third Street
videos.overview: Recess Christmas: Miracle on Third Street is a Disney direct-to-video animated film, released on November 6, 2001. The movie shows the last day of school before Christmas break, as Mr. Prickley, Mrs. Finster and Mrs. Grokee remember the times that they've had with the children. The movie is compiled from four unrelated episodes including the series' Christmas special "Yes Mikey, Santa Does Shave".

videos.title: All Growed Down
videos.overview: Recess: All Growed Down is a Disney direct-to-video animated film released on December 9, 2003. In this movie, the Recess gang remembers how they all met back in Kindergarten.

videos.title: Taking the Fifth Grade
videos.overview: Recess: Taking the Fifth Grade is a Disney direct-to-video animated film released on December 9, 2003. It is considered the series finale to the show.

videos.title: The Break In
videos.overview: The main kids try to get all the other kids to help rescue T.J. when Miss Finster punishes him by making him miss recess.

videos.title: The New Kid
videos.overview: New kid Gus arrives at Third Street Elementary, but has to endure the indignities that a new kid must undergo.

videos.title: The Experiment
videos.overview: The kids carry out a crucial experiment to see if it's really true that kissing each other is an inevitable part of their future.

videos.title: The Great Jungle Gym Stand Off
videos.overview: The kids stage a protest when Principal Prickly plans to tear down Ol' Rusty to replace it with a new jungle gym.

videos.title: Jinxed
videos.overview: The Ashleys jinx Gus according to the playground rules so that he can't talk until his friends say his name.

videos.title: Officer Mikey
videos.overview: The others try to help out when Mikey wants to be a safety ranger.

videos.title: First Name Ashley
videos.overview: The Ashleys try to force Spinelli to be just like them when Spinelli's first name is revealed.

videos.title: To Finster with Love
videos.overview: The kids help bring Miss Finster together with Hank the janitor when they find out she has a crush on him.

videos.title: King Gus
videos.overview: Bob installs Gus as a substitute king while he has a tonsilectomy, figuring Gus will be easy to control - but Gus turns into a despot instead.

videos.title: Big Brother Chad
videos.overview: The kids, and Vince himself, come to the awful realization that Vince's once popular older brother Chad has grown up into a geek.

videos.title: My Fair Gretchen
videos.overview: The kids come up with a plan to keep Gretchen from being transferred to Oppenheimer Elementary for the Incredibly Extremely Gifted.

videos.title: Speedy, We Hardly Knew Ye
videos.overview: The kids stage an elaborate funeral for the 4th grade class's beloved hamster, wherein they learn about how many lives the hamster has touched.

videos.title: I Will Kick No More Forever
videos.overview: Vince completely loses his confidence at playing kickball when Ashley Q. beats him in a game.

videos.title: The Kid Came Back
videos.overview: A weird little boy keeps tagging along behind the kids, apparently causing a streak of bad luck.

videos.title: The Pest
videos.overview: Jeffrey, an annoying jerk of a boy, insists that Gretchen will be his girlfriend.

videos.title: The Legend of Big Kid
videos.overview: What do the kindergarteners have planned for T.J. when they capture him?

videos.title: The Box
videos.overview: Miss Finster comes up with a new punishment that reduces T.J. to a vegetable.

videos.title: The Trial
videos.overview: Randall accuses Spinelli of hitting him with a rock during a dirt clod war so the kids put her on trial.

videos.title: Teachers Lounge
videos.overview: The kids dream about what the teachers' lounge must be like.

videos.title: Randall's Reform
videos.overview: Loneliness compels Randall to want to make friends with the other kids.

videos.title: Rainy Days
videos.overview: The kids grow increasingly frustrated when rain keeps then indoors for recess days on end.

videos.title: The Great Can Drive
videos.overview: At first only Mikey wants to participate in the Thanksgiving can drive competition against the unbeatable Ashleys.  But then the other kids join in to beat the Ashleys.

videos.title: The Voice
videos.overview: Principal Prickly needs Mikey to sing the National Anthem at the PTA Spring Fling, but Mikey only sings well in the bathroom.  So he brings in a music teacher to bring the Robert Goulet out of Mikey.

videos.title: Kids in the Mist
videos.overview: The kids deal with a pompous expert on child research who wants to study them as they play.

videos.title: Parents' Night
videos.overview: Spinelli will do anything to keep her parents from attending parents' night and meeting the others.

videos.title: Swing on Thru to the Other Side
videos.overview: Spinelli is inspired to form a cult based on the Swinger Girl when she thinks she's seen her swing over the top into another dimension.

videos.title: The Break-Up
videos.overview: The gang breaks up when they are forced to choose a best friend to write about.

videos.title: The Hypnotist
videos.overview: A hypnotist performing for the kids inadvertantly hypnotizes Principal Prickly into thinking he's six years old.

videos.title: Mama's Girl
videos.overview: Spinelli gets labelled a mama's girl when she inadvertantly calls Ms. Grotke ""Mama.""

videos.title: Outcast Ashley
videos.overview: Ashley A. hooks up with Gretchen when she sins against the clique so gravely as to get thrown out.

videos.title: The Game
videos.overview: Gus finds a tile from the game Ajimbo and soon the entire student body gets caught in its evil grasp.

videos.title: The Lost Ball
videos.overview: Gus has to go to the Yard of No Return when he kicks a good kickball over the fence.

videos.title: Gus' Last Stand
videos.overview: Gus winds up the new target of the school bully's wrath.

videos.title: Operation Field Trip
videos.overview: All the kids go on a big field trip to MISOOE (The Museum of Industry, Science, Oceanography, Oddities and Energy).  But Ol' Smokey, the beloved school bus, breaks down in the middle of nowhere.

videos.title: The Challenge
videos.overview: A visit from Principal Prickly's brother Paul leads to a challenge between 3rd Street and 98th Street kickball teams.

videos.title: Wild Child
videos.overview: In the "Pee Wee Pals" program, the main kids each have to take care of a kindergartner during recess.

videos.title: The Substitute
videos.overview: Substitute teacher Mr. E. captivates all the kids with his command of authority, except T.J.

videos.title: Gretchen and the Secret of Yo
videos.overview: Gretchen turns to former yo-yo champ Tommy Tate to learn how to master the yo-yo.

videos.title: The Girl Was Trouble
videos.overview: Gretchen's search for her stolen laptop leads her on a journey among the school's delinquents that ultimately brings about her downfall.

videos.title: Copycat Kid
videos.overview: Mikey wants to be exactly like Vince when Vince saves his life.

videos.title: Operation Stuart
videos.overview: The kids take in a really ratty stray cat that they find near the dumpster, naming it Stuart.

videos.title: Pharaoh Bob
videos.overview: King Bob orders the kids to build him a pyramid so that all future classes will remember him.

videos.title: The Story of Whomps
videos.overview: Principal Prickly and Miss Finster deem T.J.'s word "whomps" as a cuss and punish him for it, starting a scandal that leads all the way to the board of education.

videos.title: Weekend at Muriel's
videos.overview: Miss Finster agrees to babysit Spinelli for the weekend while her parents are away.

videos.title: Economics of Recess
videos.overview: When the playground goes on the monsticker standard T.J. goes down the path from poverty to wealth.

videos.title: Omega Kids
videos.overview: The main kids wish they could have the overcrowded school to themselves, then surprisingly get their wish.

videos.title: Yes, Mikey, Santa Does Shave
videos.overview: Mikey is the only fourth grader who still believes in Santa Claus.  He tries to convince the others Santa exists.

videos.title: Bad Hair Day
videos.overview: T.J. and Vince manage to convince everyone that the bad haircut they gave Mikey is actually cool.

videos.title: Dance Lessons
videos.overview: Spinelli's parents put her in Mlle. Povlova's dance school, where she teams up with Mikey.

videos.title: Principal for a Day
videos.overview: Principal Prickly and Miss Finster plot to turn T.J. over to their own side by making him principal for a day.

videos.title: The Beauty Contest
videos.overview: The Ashleys get back at Spinelli by entering her into the Kiddie Cosmetics Little Miss Blush Beauty Pageant. But her friends talk Spinelli into trying to beat the Ashleys in the pageant.

videos.title: One Stayed Clean
videos.overview: On class picture day, the kids vow to keep Gus clean as he's never had a class picture of him taken.

videos.title: A Genius Among Us
videos.overview: Someone else besides Gretchen is a math genius, and through math, Gretchen starts a close relationship with this person.

videos.title: Dodgeball City
videos.overview: The main kids discover that Gus was once a notorious dodgeball player who went by the name of El Diablo.

videos.title: A Career to Remember
videos.overview: A career day assembly gets all the kids to decide their future careers.  That is all except Spinelli.

videos.title: Kindergarten Derby
videos.overview: Every year the older kids pick kindergarteners to race in the Kindergarten Derby. This year an eager Tubby gets an unwilling Mikey to sponsor him in the race.

videos.title: The Bet
videos.overview: Fed up with Vince's ego, the kids bet Vince that he can't go one whole day without beating someone in a sport.

videos.title: Space Cadet
videos.overview: T.J. takes charge when Gretchen seems to achieve a dream that T.J.'s always had, to be an astronaut on the space shuttle.

videos.title: Stand Up Randall
videos.overview: Randall becomes popular when he uses a joke book to make himself a standup comedian.

videos.title: The Shiner
videos.overview: T.J. shows up in school with a black eye. Everyone makes up wild stories about the heroic acts T.J. must have done to get the shiner.

videos.title: Lord of the Nerds
videos.overview: T.J. breaks his clavicle and now has to spend recess with the ""pale kids"" in Room 51.

videos.title: That Stinking Feeling
videos.overview: Spinelli gets a crush on a fifth grader and has to get over it to save her reputation.

videos.title: My Funny Valentines
videos.overview: In his hatred of Valentine's Day, T.J. sends a ""funny"" valentine to every single girl on the playground to show them how stupid Valentine's Day is, but his plan soon backfires when the girls mistake them for ""real"" valentine cards.

videos.title: The Barnaby Boys
videos.overview: T.J. and Vince are so into the "Barnaby Boys" books that they dress up like the Barnaby Boys and try to solve the mystery of the suspicious substitute janitor, Earl Raymond.

videos.title: Buried Treasure
videos.overview: TJ receives an old history textbook with a treasure map that leads the gang, Randall, and the Ashleys out to get the treasure. But as they get closer, greed arises and the 4th graders fight for the treasure.

videos.title: The Library Kid
videos.overview: When the gang catches the mysterious ""Libray Kid"", they take her out to recess where she becomes obssessed with the playground.

videos.title: The Ratings Game
videos.overview: Everyone is segregrated once the Ashley's start giving ratings to everyone on the playground.

videos.title: The First Picture Show
videos.overview: Señor Fusion: the Movie finally opens and T.J. vows to be there at its first screening.

videos.title: The Big Prank
videos.overview: The kids rope T.J. into a challenge to play a prank on King Bob before the end of the school day.

videos.title: Hustler's Apprentice
videos.overview: Gus winds up working for the Hustler Kid to pay off a debt, and soon he himself becomes the biggest hustler in the playground.

videos.title: The Spy Who Came In from the Playground
videos.overview: The main kids make a friend of new kid James Stone and show him all their little schemes, but soon regret that.

videos.title: Gus' Fortune
videos.overview: The kids find a paper fortune teller on the ground that predicts doom for Gus.

videos.title: Rumor Mill
videos.overview: The kids want to find out who started a rumor that a boy knocked over Mikey's popcorn at the movies and Mikey then threw the boy into the girl's bathroom.

videos.title: Recess is Cancelled
videos.overview: Secretary of Schools Garrison chooses 3rd Street School as the place to test his program to bring test scores up by cancelling recess.

videos.title: Tattletale Heart
videos.overview: The kids warn Gus not to break the code by telling Miss Finster who started a food fight.

videos.title: The Madness of King Bob
videos.overview: King Bob abandons his throne in his obsessive pursuit of pulling a prank on T.J. in this sequel to The Big Prank

videos.title: Call Me Guy
videos.overview: Gus takes a new identity when he discovers that people think he's a different cool kid when he doesn't wear them. Too bad "Guy" can't see a thing.

videos.title: Prickly is Leaving
videos.overview: Prickly finally gets his appointment to Spiro T. Agnew Middle School. But the kids try to make him stay after they meet the new Principal Slicer.

videos.title: Randall's Friends
videos.overview: Randall gets the main kids to pretend that they're his friends when his father, Leonard, visits the school on Randall's birthday.

videos.title: The Biggest Trouble Ever
videos.overview: The gang gets busted when they accidentally break a statue of a famous hero.

videos.title: The Rules
videos.overview: The original 1935 edition of The Rules of the Playground is discovered in the library.

videos.title: Gus and Misdemeanors
videos.overview: The bad kids from The Girl was Trouble trick Gus into shoplifting candy from Kelso's.

videos.title: A Science Fair to Remember
videos.overview: Second grade prodigy Becky Benson befriends Gretchen to get help for her science fair project. But she has an ulterior motive.

videos.title: Mikey's Pants
videos.overview: The gang tries to cover up Mikey's ripped pants so Finster won't catch him.

videos.title: Here Comes Mr. Perfect
videos.overview: Jared, the new student, appears to be perfect, making the rest of the school very jealous.

videos.title: Good Luck Charm
videos.overview: Spinelli gets too attached to the lucky marble that Vince loans her.

videos.title: Diggers Split Up
videos.overview: Digger Dave quits digging and then bosses everyone around.

videos.title: Schoolworld
videos.overview: The school gets a new technology system installed called the SAL 3000 which controls everything.

videos.title: Bachelor Gus
videos.overview: Thinking his family is moving away again, Gus moves under the jungle gym to avoid leaving his friends and school

videos.title: The Dude
videos.overview: T.J. and the gang meet Mr. Dudicoff, a student teacher who was a legend at 3rd Street School back in the day.

videos.title: Partners in Crime
videos.overview: Menlo and Randall team up to manipulate the entire playground.

videos.title: The Candidates
videos.overview: Gretchen and Vince both run for president.

videos.title: This Brain for Hire
videos.overview: People start paying Gretchen for doing their homework so she can buy herself a new bike

videos.title: Spinelli's Masterpiece
videos.overview: Spinelli channels her anger into a playground chalk drawing.

videos.title: Nobody Doesn't Like T.J.
videos.overview: T.J. can't figure out why Gordy doesn't like him.

videos.title: Yope from Norway
videos.overview: When a new kid from Norway comes to 3rd Street School, Gus befriends the kid by making him think that Gus is the hottest kid in the school.

videos.title: Bonky Fever
videos.overview: Scared of turning 10 on his soon-to-be bithday, Mikey develops an obssession of becoming a little kid again so he won't have to grow up.

videos.title: Don't Ask Me
videos.overview: Spinelli becomes popular as an advice giver when she sits in for Guru Kid.

videos.title: The Secret Life of Grotke
videos.overview: Ms. Grotke's strange behavior makes the kids think that she's a spy.

videos.title: The Fuss Over Finster
videos.overview: Miss Finster hurts her leg and can't keep up with the kids during recess.

videos.title: Soccer Boy
videos.overview: Mikey makes the other kids regret not letting them play on their team for the playground's soccer tourney.

videos.title: Fort Tender
videos.overview: The bored main kids build their own fort. But then Lawson takes it over.

videos.title: Germ Warfare
videos.overview: Gus starts an obsessive crusade to kill all the germs in the world, while Mikey will do anything to save them.

videos.title: More Like Gretchen
videos.overview: Spinelli gets peeved with her parents heap so much praise for Gretchen at her expense.

videos.title: Prince Randall
videos.overview: Randall uses an embarrassing photo to blackmail King Bob into making him Playground Prince.

videos.title: Me No Know
videos.overview: Vince feels like an outsider after he misses the must-see movie of the weekend.

videos.title: Good Ole T.J.
videos.overview: Gretchen is worried when she's partnered with T.J. on a class project.

videos.title: Chez Vince
videos.overview: Disgusted by the horrible cafeteria food, Vince becomes the new school cook when the other kids try his cooking.

videos.title: Tucked In Mikey
videos.overview: Needing to prepare himself for a poet laureate ceremony, Mikey decides to listen to Menlo to learn how to organize himself.

videos.title: Old Folks Home
videos.overview: Mikey badgers the gang into a trip to senior citizens home.

videos.title: Some Friend
videos.overview: T.J. has a mysterious new friend.

videos.title: The Coolest Heatwave Ever
videos.overview: During a burning hot day, the gang attempts to make it across the playground to the otherside where there is a water pump.

videos.title: No Strings Attached
videos.overview: The gang is suspicious when the Ashleys give Spinelli six wrestling tickets.

videos.title: Beyond a Reasonable Scout
videos.overview: Mikey and Gus want to join the Woodchuck Scouts.

videos.title: The C Note
videos.overview: T.J. finds a $100 bill and along with the gang try to find out who lost it.

videos.title: The Army Navy Game
videos.overview: Gus and Theresa (Cornchip Girl) have a hard time becoming friends due to their rivaling fathers.

videos.title: Big Ol' Mikey
videos.overview: After Mikey helps Cornchip Girl off the climbing frame after she gets stuck, the gang wonder how big he will be. Gretchen and Galileo conduct a test to find out how big everyone will be when they are older, and Mikey's test says he will be 50 feet tall! The others find this cool and wonder what 50 foot Mikey could do, but Mikey isn't so sure that being 50 feet tall will be that great.

videos.title: A Great State Fair
videos.overview: Gus must stay behind from the fair because he forgot his permission slip, while the rest of the gang try to figure out a way to get Gus to the fair.

videos.title: The A.V. Kid
videos.overview: Vince and T.J. compete for the job as A.V. Kid, but their competition leads to a broken-up friendship between them.

videos.title: The Principals of Golf
videos.overview: The kids think Vince is getting special treatment when he becomes Prickly's golf partner.

videos.title: All the Principal's Men
videos.overview: The gang tries to find out who removed all the balls from the playground.

videos.title: Lawson and His Crew
videos.overview: Tired of TJ and his friends getting all the glory from King Bob, Lawson decides to get a gang of his own together. He recruits Randall, Menlow, Swinger Girl, Skeenes and Kurst the Worst and together the six start solving the playground's problems and getting the glory. Of course TJ and his friends now have nothing to do, so they are left just talking and eventually realise that just being friends is much better than getting all the glory they used to have. Friends being something that Lawson and his crew are definitely not ...

videos.title: Terrifying Tales of Recess
videos.overview: In this Hallowe'en episode, Butch tells us three terrifying tales of Recess. Children of the Cornchip: Cornchip Girl eats some untested cornchips and turns into a werekid! The gang have to save her.  When Bikes Attack!: The bikes that the kids ride to school everyday become alive and turn against their riders.  Night of the Living Finsters: Lawson challenges Vince to spend the night in the graveyard, only for the gang to discover that the school is built on the Finster family graveyard.

videos.title: Kurst the Not So Bad
videos.overview: Mikey's new friendship with Kurst the Worst doesn't sit well with their friends.

videos.title: League of Randalls
videos.overview: Randal recruits the Tylers, the Ashleys' little brothers, to help him snitch.

videos.title: Mundy, Mundy
videos.overview: Bad-guy Mundy becomes very poular after he prevents a ball from hitting a little kid.

videos.title: Lost Leader
videos.overview: When one of T.J.s plans goes wrong and Gus breaks his leg he won't make another plan.  It's up to the others to get T.J. back to his old self
